Sofia, I posted the bullets in #coastal-team for June:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living.
- "PHL" is ambiguous: Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal) uses it too. Use the full name when filtering or labelling.

I added the Pellucid line because the February #coastal-team thread shows the two getting mixed up. The post has no account figures. I haven't sent June a direct message, so if you want her to get it directly, tell me and I'll do that.
